This scene:
神农和他的家人住在古代，所以不知道什么植物能吃。因为他的家人常常生病了，所以神农和他的哥哥一起去旅行找可以吃的植物。他们去很多不一样的地方，比方说高山、山谷和沙漠。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 神农和他的家人住在古代：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
- 因为他的家人常常生病了：常常生病，no了for routine/habit
- 他们去很多不一样的地方：去了，了completed

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 住在古代：生活在古代，古代 is a historical time period rather than a physical place of residence; use 生活在古代 to place the characters in that era. [rule: time_expression]
2. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农：一个叫神农的人，On a character’s first mention, introduce the person with both a name and a noun such as 人, rather than assuming the reader already knows the name. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
3. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 常常生病了：常常生病，A habitual action takes the zero particle; 了 does not mark a routine action. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
4. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 去很多不一样的地方：去了很多不一样的地方，The visits to many places are completed narrative actions, so use 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: “住在古代” can correctly mean living in ancient times, so replacing it with “生活在古代” is only an unnecessary stylistic change.
This is the character’s first mention, so introducing 神农 as a person is required by the teacher’s reference rule.
“常常” describes a habitual situation, so “生病” should not take perfective 了.
The trip to many places is a completed narrative event, so “去了很多不一样的地方” is correct.
